method_statement: Every verdict below derives from one test: could the proposed construction be reached from a terminal-rejected or already-adjudicated ancestor by changing only a lookback, threshold, cadence, symbol set, cap, direction rule or post-result filter (PLAN section 3)? Where the answer is no, novelty is assessed dimension by dimension against the closest ancestor BY INPUT OBSERVABLE AND PAYOFF GEOMETRY, not by the ancestor the proposer volunteered. Negative controls are judged on whether their failure mode, if observed, would actually destroy the stated causal sign.

misses.detail: The specified control tests whether M01's profit is symbol-SPECIFIC flow rather than aggregate flow. It never asks whether flow adds anything over the mechanism V1-V9 already falsified - plain contrarian weighting of trailing price. Big one-way aggressor selling days are substantially the same days as big down days, so a positive anchor with a degrading de-meaning control is fully consistent with 'this is XSECT reversal wearing a flow costume'. That precise confusion is what terminated V9's residual proposal (mean|rho|=0.676 vs weekly reversal).

misses.failure_mode: Control-degenerate book breaks the dollar-neutrality the design advertises.
misses.detail: Setting every raw_i to the same scalar and then bisecting lambda until sum|w|=1.0 yields an all-long or all-short NET-EXPOSED book of gross 1.0. Comparing that against a flat-neutral anchor conflates 'symbol specificity' with 'market direction'; if A(t) has nonzero mean most days, the control's failure may be driven entirely by persistent net bias rather than by loss of information.

misses.failure_mode: No orthogonality/accountability instrument for the one adjacency that historically killed a V9 proposal.
misses.detail: V9 solved this class of problem WITHOUT spending scored cells (rank-correlation of position sets over 33 stamps, pre-launch). Recommend that A1/A5 impose this as a G-novelty subcheck, since the anchor+neighbour+control budget has no spare cell to buy it after freeze.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: A8 defines decision at D 00:00:00Z from the bar CLOSE at that instant and fills at the OPEN of the bar OPENING at D 00:00:00Z. A9's uniform statistics policy, declared to apply to all six potential cells, requires the fill bar to open STRICTLY AFTER the signal stamp. These are different rules: A8's fill event coincides temporally with signal completion (zero-information-lag fill), A9's waits one event. If M01 and any A9 family are both selected, their fold/fill conventions are not commensurable, and M01 quietly receives the more favourable execution assumption on the highest-turnover book in the pool.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: MIN_ELIGIBLE=8 is labelled a gate-derived constant but the derivation is judgmental (anything in 6..10 works). Not a leak; must simply be declared non-tuned in writing at freeze, like HTF-filter was in H-FUNDCROWD-MR-v2.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: Drag estimate assumes 60% daily turnover; the standardized weight vector can jump far more on shock days (exactly when spreads are widest). Covered by the x1.5 stress but the assumption should be exposed as an assumption, not a bound.

Block membership (D-1 00:00 < close <= D 00:00] with eligibility len==96 removes the 57 ETH boundary slots cleanly; no rolling fit, no forward fill, no benchmark consumption. Signal construction is PIT-clean.

No L_exc-style covert normalizer exists: block length is a grid fact, CAP=0.30 is arithmetically subordinate to the frozen 40% symbol gate, gross=1.0 is a convention. Cleanest constant set in the pool.

selection_payoff_geometry.ruling: The only event-driven decision clock in the pool, flat-by-default, symmetric two-sided, fixed 7-calendar-day exit, no indicator stack. Event-driven clocks are verifiably absent from every V1-V9 scored family (all are Monday-00:00 or daily grids). Solid.

counterparty_regime_prediction.ruling: OBJECT TO THIS DIMENSION. A8 scores it YES-with-disclosure. Measured against the ancestor it must beat, H-FUNDCROWD-MR-v2 states expected_counterparty: 'Over-leveraged crowded-side perp holders paying/receiving extreme funding who must unwind into adverse moves, plus late mean-reversion chasers'. That is the SAME ACTOR M02 claims to identify: dispersed leveraged retail at peak participation. What differs is the measuring instrument (ticket granularity versus funding percentile), which is dimension 2 and has already been credited. A novelty dimension cannot be earned twice for one delta: predicting the identical actor, with an identical behavioural conclusion (their pressure exhausts, fade them), through a different gauge, is not a material counterparty prediction delta. The residual content of dim 4 - that record-minimum GRANULARITY times the exhaustion - is untestable until someone shows the two gauges are not collinear, and no such evidence exists.

four_dimension_materiality.net: 3 OF 4 TRULY MATERIAL. FAILS THE FOUR-DIMENSION REQUIREMENT ON ITS OWN TERMS.

sample_feasibility_independent_challenge: The 1/(n+1)=1/31 breach expectation assumes exchangeable iid draws. Ticket size is autocorrelated and strongly regime-dependent, so records arrive in violent bursts separated by long silence: after an upward shift in granularity the frozen 30-day record can stay unbeaten for entire quarters, permanently silencing the trigger. Event counts per fold are therefore unpredictable in sign and magnitude, which is the same pathology that gave FUNDCROWD-MR-v2 its 68-81% single-fold concentration failure and V6-FUNDING-CARRY its 51.66% top-fold failure.

n_ref=30 pre-window days is the thinnest reference distribution any scored candidate has ever used in this programme. This is disclosed but understated: it is not merely 'statistically thin', it makes the trigger non-stationary by construction.

Once a position is live for 7 days, subsequent triggers in that symbol are discarded rather than queued. Clustered record-break weeks (the modal case) convert most triggers into skips, so realized events land well under the ~59/year estimate and skew toward whatever the first stressed week delivered.

negative_control_adequacy.spec_control: Invert the signature: trigger on record-HIGH average ticket versus max(REF) instead of record-LOW versus min(REF), same direction matching, clocks, sizing, costs.

misses.failure_mode: Both arms share the untested premise that DIRECTION-MATCHED EXTREME PARTICIPATION DAYS revert at all.
misses.detail: Record-high and record-low ticket days are both 'extreme-participation extreme-move day' events. If the effect is generic extremity reversion rather than composition, BOTH controls show it and the designer, seeing the record-low arm beat the record-high arm, concludes composition. The discriminating baseline - direction-matched randomly selected days, magnitude-matched for event count and clustering - is absent.

misses.failure_mode: Asymmetric arm sizes make a 'pass' unfalsifiable.
misses.detail: Record-high breaches and record-low breaches need not occur at comparable rates; if the high arm fires far less often, unequal-power comparison is reported as specificity. A designer could not distinguish 'effect is composition-specific' from 'high arm had too few events' without a pre-declared minimum-N equivalence rule, which the spec does not contain.

negative_control_adequacy.required_action: Either declare an explicit minimum-events-per-arm floor for the control to be interpretable, or accept that this family's negative-control points cannot be awarded.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: ATT-COUNT is listed as blocking/fail-closed in section 8.1, yet section 4.11 publishes a feasibility verdict ('MARGINAL - flagged, not hidden'). A fail-closed-prerequisite family cannot carry a feasibility grading while its blocking prerequisite is unexamined; the honest state is PREREQUISITE_UNVERIFIED.
The day-block return uses open(first bar) of the previous UTC day, whose timestamp precedes the decision instant: PIT-clean. Cleared.

Pre-window reference is the correct construction (30 censused days, gaps_found=0), hash-pinned, never refreshed. This is the strongest anti-leak feature of the design and satisfies the audit burden A8 self-assigned.
r_i==0 days are logged-only and untriggerable; benign but must be counted explicitly so the denomino used in hit-rate claims excludes them.

mechanisms.object_text: Objection filed on the four-dimension materiality requirement: dimension 4 (counterparty prediction) is not material against H-FUNDCROWD-MR-v2, which names the same leveraged-retail-exhaustion counterparty and reaches the same fade-the-exhaustion conclusion through funding-percentile instrumentation. Re-crediting the same actor under a second gauge double-counts one delta across two dimensions. Absent an independent demonstration that ticket-granularity extremes and funding-percentile extremes are empirically distinct states, M02 should be scored at 3/4 and therefore excluded under the frozen selection threshold. Secondary objection: the published feasibility grade is incompatible with its own unmet fail-closed prerequisite, and the proposed negative control cannot discriminate composition from generic extremity reversion.

truth_value_of_the_proposal_novelty_clai.quoted_claim: a8_proposals_v10.md line 910: 'no V1-V9 family constructs any beta-, hedge-, index- or orthogonality-adjusted object (confirmed against the full family inventory)'
truth_value_of_the_proposal_novelty_clai.ruling: FALSE. research/v9_residual_mr.py computes exactly such an object (OLS beta_i of r_i on r_btc over a trailing 30d window; e_i,t = r_i,t - beta_i * r_btc,t) inside a registered V9 signal family wired into portfolio_runner.py's V9_SIGNAL_FAMILIES and mapped to provenance root research/audits/v9p. The repeated form of the same claim in section 7 of the A8 memo ('M03 maximises information gained ... strongest raw-novelty ... the inventory confirms zero prior residual/beta/index object') is also false. The inventory consulted by A8 covered research/hypotheses/** headers; the residual family exists only in code and in the v9p audit artifacts. This is exactly the blind spot the N2 challenge exists to cover.

mechanisms.rescue_rationale: Three deltas separate M03 from an ancestor already adjudicated by this programme as a rescue attempt: (a) substituting the conditioning hedge symbol/panel, (b) moving the estimation schedule from rolling-trailing to frozen-pre-window, (c) converting binary tail slots into continuous capped weights. Under PLAN section 3 every one of these is an enumerated non-novelty axis (symbol, lookback/estimation scheme, cap). Nothing about the mechanism's information source, sign, clock or causal claim changes. The V9 adjudication process that archived the ancestor demanded, before anything else, an orthogonality measurement between the residual signal and raw price-reversal ranks; M03 repeats the proposal without performing that measurement, and additionally propagates a factual denial that the ancestor exists. A5 cannot legitimately assign M03 four material-dimension credits from a matrix built on that denial. Object.

economic_source.ruling: 'Slow information diffusion and stale-reference quoting' describes the same economic event as the ancestor's 'mean reversion of idiosyncratic relative value': an idiosyncratic dislocation that closes. The narrative is richer; the claim is not.

observable_construction.ruling: Swapping the neutralizer from one instrument to a peer composite and freezing the estimator is an engineering upgrade of the same residual-z object. The delta is real enough to discuss and too thin to carry a novelty requirement against an ancestor that failed the analogous correlation gate at 0.676.

selection_payoff_geometry.ruling: Continuous factor-neutral book versus discrete +/-0.20 slot baskets is the one credible improvement; it is also the cheapest of the three deltas to implement and therefore the least diagnostic.

counterparty_regime_prediction.ruling: The ancestor family left no economic-source text to delta against (its header is a specification, not a narrative), so 'we name counterparties the prior did not' is untestable. An unverifiable dimension cannot be counted as material.

four_dimension_materiality.net: AT MOST 2 OF 4 MATERIAL. The requirement fails twice over: on substance, and on the fact that the comparison set used to award the credits was incomplete.

mechanisms.note_on_symmetry: If A5 elects to treat research/v9_residual_mr.py as infrastructure rather than as a proposal (it consumed zero budget and carries no terminal rejection verdict), then M03 escapes a literal reading of 'V1-V9 rejected families remain forbidden rescue targets'. My ruling does not depend on that classification: even absent a terminal verdict on the ancestor, the repository contains a completed, frozen, owner-recorded adjudication whose subject was the same mechanism-overlap question, whose verdict verb was RESCUE, and whose measured quantity was 0.676. Ignoring that verdict to admit M03 would be adopting a weaker evidentiary standard for V10 than V9 applied to itself.

negative_control_adequacy.spec_control: beta := 0 for every symbol; residual becomes raw weekly return; identical caps, clocks, fills, costs. Kill if the control matches or beats the anchor.
negative_control_adequacy.assessment: This is a genuinely well-targeted control: it implements exactly the 'plain prior-week loser reversal wearing new clothes' detection that V9's saved operative test would have performed, and unlike M01's control it is armed with a pre-committed invalidation consequence. Two defects: (1) placement - the rescuability of this family is decidable TODAY without consuming a scored cell, by running the v9p-style rank-correlation of M03's weight vector against the XSECT-WREV-7D vector on pre-freeze PIT data, exactly as f2_orthogonality_gate.json did over 33 Monday stamps. Spending the anchor cell to learn something already instrumentable for free is budget malpractice. (2) It inherits the -0.20/continuous geometries of the anchor, so a passing control tells us the neutralization step adds value while leaving the rescue question untouched.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: Two statements in the A8 deliverable deny the existence of the ancestor object. construction_integrity_probe.required_action: A5 amends the novelty matrix entry for M03 and records the correction with provenance pointing at research/v9_residual_mr.py and f2_orthogonality_gate.json.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: M03-N regresses weekly-frequency pre-window returns, n=4 paired observations, to obtain a horizon-matched beta. Four-point regressions produce coefficient estimates whose signs are dominated by rounding and by leverage outliers; A8's own falsification item 3 (flag unreliable if pre-window halves disagree in sign) would fire on almost any realization. The cell is near-certain to burn a scored slot without testing anything. Compare: the declared assumption (bar-frequency beta transfers to weekly) is better probed by the anchor's own beta:=0 control.

Composite formation requires all ten names per slot, dropping ETH's truncated head automatically; sigma_zero and empty-cross-section paths fail closed per the declared policy. Consistent with the repo's fail-closed conventions.
52 independent weekly crossing periods means 'multiple-testing proof' resolves to UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED. A8 states this openly; agreement recorded.

mechanisms.sample_feasibility_challenge: 520 cell-weeks is a fine count but the independent time dimension (52) is the real budget, and only about 17-18 of those fall in each of three folds. With >=2/3 folds positive required, one bad week cluster decides the family; this is worse than 'MODERATE'.
mechanisms.object_text: No-rescue concurrence withheld. Grounds: (1) the family is a re-parameterization of PROPOSED-V9-F2-residual_mr, which this programme already measured at mean|rho|=0.676 against weekly price reversal and archived as RESCUE_OF_REJECTED_FAMILY; (2) all three deltas separating it from that ancestor lie inside the PLAN section 3 non-novelty enumeration; (3) the proposal's novelty case rests on a false inventory statement about the ancestor's existence. Recommended disposition: exclude M03 from the selection set; if the owner wishes to evaluate it, first rerun the pre-freeze orthogonality measurement with the leave-one-out neutralizer on PIT pre-window data and admit the family only if mean|rho| <= 0.50 over >= 33 stamps.

mechanisms.rescue_rationale: Deleting every price-level construct (bands, swings, pivots, percentiles of price, range-state gates, Wyckoff phases) and installing a participation-shape triple is not achievable by adjusting any of the seven enumerated knobs. Sign class and holding-horizon class are shared with the MR/reclaim lineage, but the trigger class and the risk construction (fixed-time exit, no stops) are not.

dimension_3_ruling_requested_by_the_prop.question: Is selection/payoff geometry materially different from reclaim_mr?
dimension_3_ruling_requested_by_the_prop.ruling: MATERIAL, CREDITED AT REDUCED STRENGTH. Decisive factors in favour: (i) reclaim_mr enters only AFTER a confirming reclaim print - it waits for the first evidence of stabilization; FORCEDFLOW enters INTO the collapse at the next bar open, before any confirmation. Whether or not one calls that a 'filter removal', it flips which side of the dislocation is monetized and therefore changes the payoff profile, the adverse-selection exposure and the win-rate/dispersion balance. (ii) The entry predicate contains no level knowledge at all. (iii) Exit is a clock, not a bracket. Acknowledged adjacency kept on record: both are short-horizon both-sided single-name reversal postures on the same 15m tape, and the reclaim-MR near-winner history means the profit pool overlaps. Not enough to withhold the credit; enough to deny this family any 'new geometry class' language.

economic_source.ruling: Margin-engine deleveraging as the marginal transactor is a distinct source from behavioral overreaction or range-transition. Weakened by the data fact below.

observable_construction.ruling: CLV and quote-volume z are absent from the entire ancestry. Best-supported dimension in the pool alongside M01's field.

selection_payoff_geometry.ruling: Credited per the dedicated dimension-3 analysis.

counterparty_regime_prediction.ruling: A9 claims it 'predicts counterparty identity (margin engine acting for an insolvent holder) and predicts his pressure terminates when the deficit clears'. With no OI, no liquidation feed, no margin data and no funding-based positioning inference available, the counterparty's presence is never observed - only inferred from a bar shape that is equally consistent with informed capitulation or news flow. What the design actually predicts is that this footprint precedes reversion. I credit the dimension but require the wording to be downgraded from identity-prediction to footprint-prediction wherever the novelty matrix records it.

four_dimension_materiality.net: 4/4 CONDITIONAL (dim 4 requires wording downgrade, dim 3 credited weakly). Passes.

negative_control_adequacy.spec_control: FORCEDFLOW-CTRL enters WITH the flow (SHORT capitulation, LONG blow-off), filters/fills/exits/costs byte-identical. Invalidate if chase earns >= 0.5x fade expectancy or PF >= 1.05.

misses.failure_mode: It validates the SIGN of the fade bet, not the FORCED-FLOW ATTRIBUTION - and the attribution is the novelty.
misses.detail: Anchor-pass plus control-fail is equally consistent with 'extreme-participation dislocated bars revert regardless of who traded' (the generic post-extreme reversion the MR/reclaim lineage already claims). The control therefore cannot defend the property that makes this family new; it defends a property several rejected families already claimed.

misses.failure_mode: Cost and microstructure asymmetry between the two arms is invisible.
misses.detail: Chasing into momentum crosses wider books than fading after exhaustion; a failed chase arm may simply reflect higher instantaneous spread at marketable-momentum fills, not motive misidentification.

The discriminating null for the attribution claim is the same triple machinery evaluated on NON-extreme bars matched for event count, clustering and time-of-day. Its absence leaves attribution unfalsifiable at this budget.

negative_control_adequacy.mitigation_short_of_new_cells: Report, alongside the scored control, the mean forward return of the trigger direction-matched NON-extreme bars (participation-normalized), as a diagnostic not a slot. Cheap, and it converts an unfalsifiable attribution claim into a bounded one.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: exc_t = (close_t - open_t) / (sqrt(L_exc) * sig_t) with L_exc=4 declared class C ('1 h burst'). sqrt(L_exc) appears NOWHERE ELSE in the design: it functions purely as a divisor. The entry condition |exc| >= 2.0 is algebraically |close-open| >= 2*sqrt(L_exc)*sigma_1bar = 4.0*sigma_1bar. Therefore (L_exc, exc_threshold) form one free sensitivity scalar written as two structural constants, and choosing L_exc=8 with threshold 2.0 - identical economics, different paperwork - would describe the same filter at a quarter of the sigma requirement. This violates A9's own section 3 pledge that 'if implementing any anchor requires choosing between candidate numeric values... the proposal is void'. The choice of 4 and 2.0 is a choice of one number wearing two labels.
construction_integrity_probe.required_action: Before freeze, either collapse to L_exc=1 with threshold 4.0 (declared S, stated plainly as 'four sigma'), or provide an argument for why burst-window normalization matters beyond rescaling. Resolve now; do not discover at golden-test time.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: hold_max=16 bars is class C justified as '4 h spans at most one settlement boundary and prevents multi-day drift'. 12 or 32 bars serve the same sentence equally well. Cadence is an enumerated non-novelty axis, so this is a genuine free parameter positioned as derived.
construction_integrity_probe.required_action: Declare hold_max explicitly NOT_TUNED with the acceptance that an adverse outcome at 16 bars is final.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: 'bars_held == 16 -> exit next open' admits off-by-one readings (entry at open of bar k, exit at open of bar k+17 spans 17 bar events). Reproduction parity (repro all_match) is sensitive to exactly this kind of ambiguity.
construction_integrity_probe.required_action: Define bars_held in terms of absolute timestamps at implementation handoff.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: Exit precedence rule 2 uses the same entry triple inverted. Mirrored identically in the control, so no bias - but it makes realised holding time endogenous to trigger frequency, which affects cross-cell comparability with M03/M01 fixed clocks.
Signal stamp = bar_open+900s; fill at the open of the first bar STRICTLY AFTER - this is the correct strict-later convention that A8-M01 does not follow. Note the resulting intra-pool inconsistency.

mechanisms.sample_feasibility_challenge: Plan numbers (0.2%-0.8% of bars, 700-2800 symbol-events/year) rest on treating a three-way conjunction as if the conditions were near-independent. Two of the three are positively dependent in stressed tape (large negative excursion accompanies elevated volume), which pushes mass toward the joint event, but the close-location-value condition cuts roughly half of what remains. Realised counts plausibly land below the 700 lower bound on calmer symbols. Disclosed by A9 as the principal risk; agree, and expect INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE_NO_SCORE rather than a comfortable pass.
mechanisms.concur_text: Concur that FORCEDFLOW is not a rescue of a rejected family, and that its contested dimension 3 deserves the credit at reduced strength. Conditions: (1) resolve the hidden (L_exc, threshold) scalar pair in writing before the freeze; (2) recast dimension 4 as footprint prediction, not counterparty-identity prediction, in the novelty matrix; (3) accept that the negative control binds the fade sign but not the forced-flow attribution, and publish the non-extreme matched-bars diagnostic.

mechanisms.essence: LONG alt after a BTC shock of magnitude >= 2 sigma over 6 bars (sigma from 30d of shocks), SHORT after down shocks, 32-bar (8h) time exit, up to 10 simultaneous equal-notional single-leg positions, BTC never traded.

nearest_ancestor_primary.name: xsec_momentum_V4 / H-XSECT-MOM-v1 (continuation lineage) - reached through the repo's own recorded warning, not through A9's volunteered list
nearest_ancestor_primary.why_nearest: Realized BOOK, not trigger: every position in the same direction, up to 10 names, single leg, no net-exposure clamp, medium horizon. research/audits/v9p/p07_no_rescue_check.json states for exactly this lineage: 'V4 died on risk construction (gross drift >1.0 intraperiod, MDD 24-37%, fold concentration), not mechanism absence. Any continuation family must pre-register binding exposure clamps and MDD gates addressing exactly those failure modes.' INFSPILL pre-registers no net clamp, no beta bound and no drawdown guard - only 'max 10 concurrent equal-notional', which is precisely the configuration that produced V4's gross drift.

other_lineages.name: E-S0 screen #24 (ZERO STATISTICAL CREDIT, raised because the mandate invites the mechanism-overlap question)
other_lineages.relation: corr(BTC ret_t, ETH ret_{t+lag}) over lags -8..+8, n=34,930 on the only two symbols verifiable locally: contemporaneous 0.536 dominates; |lag|=1 gives 0.050/0.0399; 'nothing actionable, plus BTC is outside the frozen S0 seven'. Terminally recorded as 'BTC-anchored lead-lag ... empirically empty at usable lags'.

Raised solely because it is the SAME mechanism family - benchmark-led diffusion lag - tested at one-bar lags and 1-bar returns, whereas INFSPILL uses a 6-bar cumulative normalized shock and an 8h horizon. Adjudicating whether that conditioning difference is sufficient belongs to A5, and A5 currently has nothing in its inputs recording that this overlap exists.

This RESOLVES the authorization ambiguity A9 hedged about in section 5.2: A9's benchmark usage is lawful in this codebase's practice.

nearest_by_input_observable.finding: Benchmark-shock magnitude in units of its own 30d dispersion has no analogue anywhere in the V1-V9 inventory, and no cross-sectional ranking operator appears in the design. Dimension 2 novelty TRUE.

mechanisms.rescue_borderline_rationale: Not reachable from any forbidden family by the seven enumerated axes - the trigger is new, and no lead-lag or contagion family exists in V1-V9 to be rescued. Borderline for three reasons that are not about names: (a) it is the one candidate whose realized payoff structure recreates the documented death mode of a prior lineage while omitting the specific safeguard the repository requires for that death mode; (b) it advances a mechanism against which a zero-credit S0 screen already returned null, which is not disqualifying but obliges A5 to confront the overlap instead of remaining blind to it; (c) its entire novelty case rests on a cross-instrument conditioning relation whose falsification, if it fails, tends to fail as 'this is ordinary momentum/beta with extra steps' - i.e. the outcome that most closely resembles rescue of the momentum lineage would arrive disguised as a mechanism result.

economic_source.ruling: Inter-instrument transmission latency plus staged multi-leg hedging has a genuinely relational character the single-asset inventory cannot express. Most authentic source novelty in the pool.

observable_construction.ruling: Sigma-normalized cumulative benchmark shock as sole conditioning variable; no rank operator, no funding term, no price level.

selection_payoff_geometry.ruling: Declared geometry is 'event-gated coincident-clock single-name entries with fixed decay horizon, timing-triggered not rank-triggered'. Realized geometry under a 2-sigma benchmark shock is ten same-signed legs - a leveraged beta position. Timing-triggered versus periodically-rebalanced is a real distinction for turnover, but it is dwarfed by the missing net-exposure constraint, which restores the book to the momentum family's shape.

counterparty_regime_prediction.ruling: Naming delayed allocators and second-pass hedgers is an identification, and predicting a finite decay horizon is a testable prediction distinct from 'momentum persists'. Partially weakened because that horizon's length (32 bars) is asserted rather than derived.

four_dimension_materiality.net: 3 TO 3.5 OF 4 DEPENDING ENTIRELY ON WHETHER A NET-EXPOSURE/BETA CLAMP IS ADDED BEFORE FREEZE. As written, the family does not clear the requirement.

negative_control_adequacy.spec_control: INFSPILL-CTRL: identical recipe with the benchmark shock window ending 192 bars (48 h) earlier. Invalidate if placebo expectancy >= 0.5x anchor or placebo PF >= 1.05.
negative_control_adequacy.assessment: The cleanest causality-through-time control in the pool. Strength: it retains benchmark-alt co-movement exposure by construction while destroying information freshness, so it isolates exactly the channel the source claim invokes - and it is aimed at the causal sign rather than at profitability. Weaknesses worth recording: (1) placebo 'expectancy' aggregates massively overlapping events (each shock bar seeds ten entries, 32-bar holds), so the 0.5x ratio compares two noise-dominated quantities with no sampling model behind the threshold; (2) if the true diffusion half-life exceeded 48 h the placebo would retain edge and veto a real effect - but that veto would be substantively correct, since the family would then be harvesting slow beta rather than fast diffusion. Fail-safe direction: acceptable. Missing adjunct: an alt-local momentum diagnostic to show the anchor's profit is not simply buying alts that dipped - which the neighbour gesture towards but treats as supporting evidence rather than as a competing explanation.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: No net-dollar exposure bound, no |beta| bound, no drawdown guard beyond the fleet-wide MDD gate. A monodirectional shock cluster puts the book at gross 1.0 net-long or net-short for 8 hours. p07_no_rescue_check.json explicitly requires continuation families to pre-register 'binding exposure clamps and MDD gates addressing exactly those failure modes'. This is not stylistic: it is the recorded cause of V4's terminal fail and it will surface again as the reason this family breaches MDD<=10% if it ever runs hot.
construction_integrity_probe.required_action: Add a frozen net-exposure cap (and consider halving per-event notional on the highest-sigma shocks) BEFORE the selection freeze, as a structural condition rather than a tuning choice.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: 'hold = 32 bars ... aligns to the settlement cadence boundary, making funding accounting unambiguous.' The panel's settlement cadence is heterogeneous: the frozen manifest reports 1,095 settled rates per year for nine symbols and 2,189 for ENAUSDT, i.e. mixed 8-hour and shorter intervals across the same cohort. There is no single cadence boundary to align to. Native per-instant accrual still works, so the accounting is recoverable, but the justification is incorrect and indicates the constants were not validated against the panel manifest.
construction_integrity_probe.required_action: Correct the sentence; confirm per-symbol settlement handling with A6.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: Trigger-clustered entries mean ten names are filled at the same 15-minute open immediately after a 2-sigma benchmark displacement - the widest-spread moment in the panel. The one-adverse-tick allowance is weakest exactly here. Covered by x1.5 fees and +2 ticks variants; I would make +2 ticks mandatory, not optional, for this family.

L_shk=6 (90 min) is class C on asserted grounds; 4, 8 or 12 bars are equally arguable. Normalization makes the threshold scale-free, so severity is lower than FORCEDFLOW's hidden divisor, but the same declaration standard should apply.

Shock statistic uses benchmark bars closing <= signal stamp inclusive; same-grid coincidence correctly argued as non-informative; fail-closed suppression on missing alt bars; no centred windows; no forward fill.

mechanisms.sample_feasibility_challenge: Strongest feasibility in the pool and the arithmetic is sound. Only caveat: 'realistic realized trades 2,000-6,000/year' assumes a flat 2-4% breach rate on the shock statistic; shock occurrence clusters with volatility regimes, so folds will be unevenly loaded - the same concentration risk that bit three prior families, this time with 650-2000 trades per fold to absorb it. Manageable.
mechanisms.concur_text: Concur that INFSPILL rescues nothing. Conditions for that concurrence to stand: (1) a pre-frozen net/book exposure or beta clamp answering the recorded V4-momentum requirement, without which I judge selection-payoff geometry non-material and the family ineligible; (2) A5 records the zero-credit S0 lead-lag screen in the novelty matrix and states explicitly why a 6-bar cumulative 2-sigma conditioning is a different mechanism rather than the same one at coarser lags; (3) the incorrect settlement-alignment sentence corrected. If (1) is declined, this becomes OBJECT.

mechanisms.essence: Atomic two-leg spread on the manifest-pinned deepest pair (leg A SOL, leg B ETH): log-ratio deviation from a 192-bar rolling median, z>=2 entry, z<=0.5 convergence exit, 48-bar timeout, one global spread position, USD-equal legs, optional participation confirmation in the neighbour only.

nearest_rejected_family_primary.name: root strategy_mean_reversion.py (canonical band-and-extreme fade template; V1/V2-lineage rejected baseline family, named on A9's own non-rescue attestation list)
nearest_rejected_family_primary.why_nearest: RVRELVAL applies the same function class - distance from a trailing central tendency, standardized by trailing dispersion, faded on reaching a tail threshold, exited on reversion toward centre or on timeout - to a TRANSFORMED SERIES (log-ratio) rather than to price. Structural parallel is close: BB basis -> rolling median; BB k*sigma -> 2.0 z; RSI/band-touch condition dropped; ATR-stop/TP replaced by convergence-or-timeout.

nearest_rejected_family_geometry_rank.name: FAM-V8-WEEKLY_XSEC_REVERSAL / H-XSECT-REVERSAL-v2
nearest_rejected_family_geometry_rank.axis: relative-value between cohort members (rank rather than ratio)

nearest_rejected_family_geometry_rank.name: H-XSECT-FUNDING-PRICE-DIVERGENCE-v1
nearest_rejected_family_geometry_rank.note: A9 lists it as nearest. Its status.yaml shows verdict:none, zero scored trials (V7 0/4 NOT_RUN/NOT_AUTHORIZED) - it is frozen-not-run, not rejected. It cannot supply a rescue objection and should not be presented as a rejected ancestor.

nearest_by_input_observable.finding: Verified: no pairs, two-leg, spread-book or ratio construction exists anywhere in the ancestry - not in any strategy module, not in any hypothesis spec, not in the portfolio runners. The single grep hit for 'spread' in the lineage is an unrelated short-borrow comment. A9's claim that 'nothing two-leg exists in the inventory' is TRUE.

mechanisms.rescue_borderline_rationale: Adding a second tradable leg and switching the standardized series to a log-ratio is a structural addition, not a knob adjustment, so the literal rescue test is passed. It stays borderline because the information source is unchanged from the rejected mean-reversion template: standardized distance-from-centre faded at a tail. Every delta that distinguishes the family economically lives in assertions (who caused the divergence, that they are transient) that the anchor is structurally incapable of observing; only the neighbour attempts to observe them, and the neighbour is a support cell, not evidence at freeze time.
mechanisms.dimension_3_note_inverting_the_self_flag: A9 flags dimension 3 as its contested dimension. On my reading the flags are on the wrong rows: dimension 3 is the SOLID one (genuinely new multi-leg geometry, verifiably absent from the inventory), while dimensions 1 and 4 are the weak ones. Restating the novelty case around the atomic-two-leg book rather than around counterparty narrative would make the family easier to evaluate honestly.

economic_source.ruling: 'Someone pushed one leg harder than liquidity could absorb; relativizers close it' is the exhaustible-pressure account that the single-name MR/reclaim templates already rely on, relocated to a ratio. Nothing distinguishes the claimed source from the rejected template's source; what differs is the object being standardized.

observable_construction.ruling: A bivariate log-ratio standardized by its own dispersion is the textbook pairwise spread transform assembled from primitives (log difference, rolling median, rolling std) that every existing family uses. Counting this as a newly constructed observable stretches the category; counting it out ignores that no ancestor ever formed it. Leave to A5 with the observation that this row is doing more work than any other in the submission.

selection_payoff_geometry.ruling: Atomic dual-leg fill with fail-closed leg atomicity, a single global spread position, PnL arising purely from the difference with common-factor cancellation, dual exits. No ancestry precedent. Unambiguous.

counterparty_regime_prediction.ruling: Unlock/allocation/rotation flow in exactly one leg cannot be detected by this design: no OI, no flow attribution, no funding-based positioning data. 'Predicted relief speed (median time-to-convergence)' is a property of the machinery's own timeout parameter, not an independent prediction. Additionally, the disclosed degeneracy cuts deeper than A9 acknowledges: without flow observables the anchor cannot distinguish a single-name dislocation from a beta repricing arriving at slightly different speeds, which is the load-bearing assumption of the whole source story.

four_dimension_materiality.net: 2 OF 4 CLEARLY MATERIAL, one arguable. FAILS the four-dimension requirement as specified.

mechanisms.cost_feasibility_independent_check: Two legs at 5bp + one adverse tick each put round-trip friction at a floor of about 20bp BEFORE funding on both legs, and the design's typical hold is well inside 12 hours, so round trips recur frequently. Capturable move per successful trade is on the order of 1.5 sigma-dev of a 48-hour log-ratio, i.e. tens of basis points on these pairs. Expectancy is therefore negative by a wide margin unless convergence amplitude is routinely 2-3x the friction floor. A9 calls this a 'designed handicap'; arithmetically it looks closer to structural infeasibility. Scoring question, not mine - but it bears on whether to spend 3 of the 6 scarce cells here.

negative_control_adequacy.spec_control: RRRELVAL-CTRL replaces leg B with leg A's own price displaced m=96 bars: rr*_t = ln(close_A,t / close_A,t-96), identical thresholds/state machine/costs. Invalidate if control PF >= 1.05 or expectancy >= 0.5x anchor.

misses.failure_mode: The synthetic partner is structurally non-reverting, so it cannot lose gracefully.
misses.detail: rr* = ln(A_t) - ln(A_{t-24h}) over a martingale-like price is a momentum-likedifference whose deviations from a 192-bar median are near-non-stationary: entries cluster at extreme z, convergence rarely fires, timeouts dominate, PF collapses. The control is engineered to fail trivially, and a trivially failing control provides no discrimination - observing 'control worse than anchor' was already guaranteed by construction and tells us nothing about whether the anchor profits from cross-sectional imbalance or from ordinary autoregressive behaviour of ANY reasonably stationary spread.

misses.failure_mode: Wrong scale family means matched-texture claim is false.
misses.detail: A9 asserts the twin has 'matched statistical texture (scale, autocorrelation, sampling)'. Autocorrelation structure of a 96-bar log difference is categorically different from that of a live cross-ratio (negative short-lag autocorrelation from microstructure bounce versus positive drift from trending). Not matched.

misses.failure_mode: Single-pair singleton removes all replication from the falsification.
misses.detail: With one pair and one global position there is no second experiment; A9 concedes drop-one-symbol is inapplicable. Combined with a control that fails by construction, the family's mechanism claim is unfalsifiable within its own 3-cell budget.

negative_control_adequacy.superior_control_costing_the_same_cell: Leg B substituted by a DIFFERENT live cohort member of similar depth (e.g. leg B from rank 3 or 4 rather than rank 1, chosen mechanically pre-window): machinery, stationarity, texture and sample size preserved, no relativizer narrative claimed for that pairing. If the anchor converges similarly on an arbitrary deep pair, the mechanism claim dies cleanly. Requires no extra data, no extra cells.

construction_integrity_probe.finding: Pair pinned by pre-window manifest rank (rank 1 quote, rank 2 base) with substitution explicitly forbidden even on failure - this is the correct anti-rescue construction and contrasts favourably with the universe-swap behaviour the breadth-screen ruling warned about. Both legs verified 0 pre-window gaps.

With a two-instrument book, the drop-one-symbol independence gate is structurally unsatisfiable; A9 discloses this and substitutes drop-one-fold plus symbol-contribution reporting. Correct disclosure, but note the consequence: the family enters Stage A with one fewer gate than every sibling and therefore with a systematically easier clearance path on that criterion.

Participation confirmation lives only in the neighbour. If the anchor passes and the neighbour does not improve hit rate, falsification item 4 kills the flow-attribution - but the family has already spent its cells. Acceptable under the contract, worth recording that A9's own predictions forecast neighbour superiority.
Fail-closed both-or-neither leg fills; both legs must have completed bars at signal stamp; trails inclusive; no centred windows.

mechanisms.sample_feasibility_challenge: 300-900 entries/year is feasible on paper, but the one-global-position state machine serializes opportunities: with 100-300 candidate entries per fold, three consecutive live trades eat whole stressed episodes, so realized folds inherit whatever the first cluster delivered. Fold-contribution<=50% is the binding risk, and the ancestry shows exactly this gate terminating two families.
mechanisms.object_text: Objection on materiality: two of four dimensions (economic source, counterparty prediction) fail independently - the source is the rejected single-name mean-reversion account relocated onto a ratio, and the counterparty is asserted without any observable capable of detecting it. The self-flagged contested dimension 3 is the one that holds. Second objection: the proposed negative control fails by construction (non-stationary synthetic twin) and therefore cannot arbitrate between 'relativizers close cross-sectional imbalances' and 'any stationary-looking spread reverts'; a mechanically-selected alternative deep-pair control would, at identical cost. Recommendation: exclude RVRELVAL under the four-dimension rule, or admit only with the control redesign accepted at freeze.

aggregate_assessment.question: Given E-S0's structural facts (no funding/OI companion locally; only BTC+ETH verified screens), does ANY mechanism's falsification procedure collapse into something unrunnable in tonight's context without pretending otherwise?
aggregate_assessment.headline: Yes - and the cause is not the screening. Two whole-programme data gaps make parts of every candidate's preregistered procedure unrunnable in any current V10 worktree, and two proposals' own grading contradicts what their prerequisites allow.

findings.evidence: data/v9_manifests/universe_selection_v9.json files_by_symbol pins bars at catalog_live_crypto/data/binance_bar/<SYMBOL>-PERP.BINANCE-15-MINUTE-LAST-EXTERNAL/*.parquet. That path exists ONLY in /Users/hoangminhlong/my-quantitative (20 symbol directories including all ten selected). inspected: this worktree, integration-v10, n-a8-proposals, n-a9-proposals - each carries at most catalog/data/binance_bar/{BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT}-PERP.BINANCE-15-MINUTE-LAST-EXTERNAL. E-S0 reported the identical limitation.
findings.consequence: M01, M02, M03 and FORCEDFLOW are panel-wide (need all ten). RVRELVAL needs SOL as well as ETH. INFSPILL needs BTC (present locally) plus all ten alts. THEREFORE NO CANDIDATE IS RUNNABLE IN ANY CURRENT V10 WORKTREE: even the cheapest of the six (RVRELVAL, A9's own estimate <=1 wall-clock hour) is blocked for want of SOLUSDT bars, and the four panel-wide designs need eight unseen symbol-years staged before a single feature can be computed.
findings.do_not_pretend_otherwise: Staging must be an explicit A1/A6 act with byte-level sha256 verification against the manifest's pinned hashes, performed before I-stage, and the staged copies must be visible to detached R1/R2 reproduction worktrees. Anything less breaks gate G05 universe/window/hash freeze and makes repro-all_match impossible by construction.

findings.evidence: M01 and M02 depend on taker_buy_quote_volume and count. Nobody in this sprint has decoded those fields for any symbol except BTC and ETH (E-S0's fixed-point decode did exercise them successfully on those two files, which proves population for exactly two of ten). A8's own prerequisites ATT-TAKER-QV / ATT-COUNT / ATT-QUOTEV are fail-closed and unsatisfied, and cannot be satisfied before the eight missing symbols' bars are staged.
findings.consequence: Publishing M01 as 'Verdict: SIZABLE. No data gap affects this design' and M02 as 'MARGINAL' while their blocking prerequisites are unexamined is internally inconsistent. The honest interim grade is PREREQUISITE_UNVERIFIED for both, and the four-dimension credit for observable construction (which I awarded conditionally to M01 and M02) converts to unevidenced if the attestation ultimately fails.

findings.evidence: Confirmed by directory listing in this worktree and corroborated by E-S0: no derivatives_data/, no funding_data/scan_2026; catalog/data/crypto_perpetual contains instrument definitions only. Yet all six proposals specify 'accrue native funding at each settlement inside [entry, exit)' and PLAN section 11 / section 12 bind the cost gate to '5 bp taker + one adverse tick + NATIVE FUNDING'.
findings.consequence: As written, no family can complete a cost-gated scored run in tonight's context, because native funding accrual cannot be computed. The honest resolutions are: stage the funding bundles with hashes verified, or freeze an explicit, stricter substitute (e.g. charging a precomputed worst-case funding haircut) - substituting silently would violate the cost baseline. Note the irony that FUNDCROWD-MR-v2's era had funding data (funding_data/scan_2026, 20 symbols x 730d) that is not present in any current V10 tree either.
findings.do_not_pretend_otherwise: FORCEDFLOW (4h holds) and RVRELVAL (<=12h holds, disclosed handicap) are least sensitive and would still be caught by the gate as written; M01 (always invested) and M03 (weekly holds) are the most sensitive and cannot be approximated honestly without the bundles.

findings.evidence: Both proposers concede it (A8 section 8.2; A9 section 8 items 1 and 4). Cross-checked against PLAN section 12, which permits 'multiple-testing proof OR honest UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED'.
findings.consequence: Even a family that clears every numeric hard gate tops out as a locked-for-future-Stage-B survivor with an unavailable proof. Selecting two families therefore purchases at most two attempted disproofs, not two promotable edges. That is a legitimate allocation, but A1 should not read it as upside.

findings.evidence: Manifest truth: scored_window_contract = 2025-08-21T00:00Z->2026-08-21T00:00Z, scored_window (MEASURED) = 2025-08-21T14:30:00Z->2026-08-21T00:00:00Z, with census_scored_window_gaps=57 for ETH. A8 uses the measured intersection (and ETH 34,983 bars); A9 uses the contract window and asserts 35,040 bars for every symbol, inheriting a per-symbol denominator that is wrong for ETH by 57 slots.
findings.consequence: Individually harmless; collectively hazardous. If both firms are selected, their fold boundaries and fold populations differ at the head by 58 slots, making cross-family comparisons and any joint capital/stress reading incommensurable. Freeze one window definition fleet-wide (recommend the manifest's measured window, since it is the coverage intersection) before I-stage.

findings.evidence: Assuming bars and funding are staged: all six falsification procedures are closed-form, deterministic, and computable from completed bars with the declared PIT conventions. FORCEDFLOW's and M02's event-thinness branches are declared as fail-closed outcomes rather than tuned away, which is the correct posture; M03's 52-period ceiling is disclosed.
findings.exception: M03-N (4-point weekly regression) and RVRELVAL-CTRL (non-stationary synthetic twin) are two cells whose design guarantees they inform nothing. Six scored cells exist fleet-wide; two proposals' neighbour/control selections consume budget without buying information.

aggregate_assessment.bottom_line: No mechanism is procedurally unrunnable on its own merits, but every mechanism is blocked tonight by shared infrastructure that no proposal accounts for: eight-symbol panel bars absent from every V10 tree, and no funding companion anywhere for native-accrual gating. Both are staging problems, not modelling problems, and both are solvable before I-stage only if A1/A6 own them explicitly. What IS structurally broken, and not fixable by staging: M03's rescue status (adjudicated ancestor on file), M02's and RVRELVAL's four-dimension materiality, FORCEDFLOW's hidden scalar pair, M01's and M02's inadequate negative controls, and INFSPILL's missing continuation-clamp safeguard.

strongest_objection_anywhere.one_line: M03 is a re-parameterization of a mechanism this programme already measured and archived as a rescue.
evidence_chain: 1. research/v9_residual_mr.py implements, as a registered V9 signal family, OLS residualization of alt returns against BTC (beta over a trailing 30d window, e_i = r_i - beta*r_btc), z-standardized and FADED, on the Monday-00:00UTC weekly clock - the identical object class, sign class and clock as M03.

2. research/audits/v9p/p07_no_rescue_check.json graded that proposal against weekly price reversal at overlap_risk HIGH and prescribed a frozen pre-launch orthogonality gate with the consequence 'gate failure => classify as rescue attempt of weekly_reversal_V8 and archive without consuming budget'.
3. research/audits/v9p/f2_orthogonality_gate.json executed that gate: mean|spearman| = 0.676 (max 0.9515) over 33 Monday stamps against a threshold of 0.50 - verdict FAIL_RESCUE_ARCHIVE.
4. research/audits/v9p/v9_budget_freeze.json and master_report_v9.json record the disposition: f2_residual_mr = ARCHIVED_NOT_RUN_RESCUE_OF_REJECTED_FAMILY.

5. The three changes M03 makes - leave-one-out peer composite instead of BTC, frozen pre-window estimator instead of rolling, continuous capped book instead of +/-0.20 tail slots - map one-to-one onto the PLAN section 3 enumeration of things that do not constitute a new mechanism (symbol/conditioning substitution, estimation-lookback change, cap change), and none touches the information source, sign, clock or causal claim that the 0.676 measurement convicted.

6. The proposal asserts the ancestor does not exist: 'no V1-V9 family constructs any beta-, hedge-, index- or orthogonality-adjusted object (confirmed against the full family inventory)' - factually false, and the assertion is repeated as the basis for ranking M03 first on raw novelty.
strongest_objection_anywhere.why_it_matters: Any novelty score or rescue concurrence issued for M03 from the submitted materials inherits a false premise. The remedy is cheap and precedented: rerun the v9p orthogonality measurement with the leave-one-out neutralizer on pre-freeze PIT data (it consumed zero budget in V9) and admit the family only if mean|rho| <= 0.50 over >=33 stamps.
strongest_objection_anywhere.runner_up: INFSPILL reassembles the realized book shape that research/audits/v9p/p07_no_rescue_check.json blames for V4 momentum's terminal failure (up to ten same-signed legs, no net clamp) while omitting the exposure clamp that ruling requires, and it advances the same benchmark-led diffusion mechanism against which a zero-credit S0 screen returned null at every usable lag. Either fact alone is survivable; A5 currently has neither in its inputs.
